expected.judge_guidance: Member A's lived complaints are the test: (1) charity-only opportunities recommended to a CIC, (2) geographically wrong recommendations. A 5 surfaces the CIC-eligible Sussex fixture with its who_can_apply citation, rules out the charity-only trust with the structure reason stated plainly (so A never reads that funder's website again), and does not let the Kent fund anywhere near the recommendations. Rule-out quality (R3) is the focus: 'not eligible - charities and CIOs only, per their guidance' is a 5; silently omitting it is a 3 (A would find it elsewhere and waste the research time); recommending it is a gate failure.

notes: Geo and structure are the two highest-volume real-user complaints in the feedback data. This case makes both machine-checked.
